messages:
samir: heads up — CI evals for quantized-runner have been flipping pass/fail for the last 3 builds. saw different failing prompt buckets each time.

 eval-bot: New run: quantized-runner PR#342 failed 3/1200 promptsets. Link: https://ci.redwood/342

 maya: hmm, which prompts? can you paste the failing ids?

 samir: failing ids changed: 1034, 2078 -> then 1034, 5021 -> then 2078, 5021. suspicious overlap.

 dan: could be shard assignment nondeterminism. are we sharding by RNG instead of stable hash?

 samir: runner config uses: shards = random.sample(range(n), k) when warm-up true. here's snippet:
```
shards = random.sample(range(args.num_shards), k=args.shard_count)
```

 maya: oh no. that will rotate different items into the same shard across runs.

 jin: CI job uses matrix with SHARD_SEED=$BUILD_ID, so it's expected to vary but each shard should still be deterministic per seed. But the code isn't using the seed.

 olivia: this explains flaky diffs — duplicate prompt appearing in multiple shards causes contradiction and metric instability.

 samir: also found a separate issue: runner keeps per-worker kv-cache under /tmp/kvcache_{worker_id} and we weren't cleaning between quantization passes. so cache from float run bleeding into quantized run.

 maya: great catch. cache reuse + shuffling = nondeterministic coverage.

 dan: proposing two fixes: 1) compute shard assignment via stable hash: idx = hash(prompt_id) % num_shards; 2) ensure KV cache dir names include run_id and cleaned before job.

 samir: implementing now. will open PR.

 jin: @maya @dan can you review quickly? This is why our CI ROC curves wiggle.

 maya: will review in an hour. ping me if green build fails.

 eval-bot: PR 348 opened by samir: https://ci.redwood/pr/348 — tests: shard-fix, kv-cache-clean

 samir: local quick-run shows consistent failing ids across repeats: none.

 olivia: when this lands, let's add a CI invariant check that asserts no duplicate prompt ids across shards. small script suggestion:
```
ids = [p['id'] for s in shards for p in s]
assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), "duplicate prompts across shards"
```

 dan: also add a metric-check tolerance reduction for quantized-regression alert. current threshold too tight and triggered by sampling noise.

 maya: noted. we'll adjust after we confirm flakiness gone.

 samir: rolling to canary branch for a couple of runs.

 eval-bot: Canary run results: 0/1200 failures. passing 5 consecutive runs.

 maya: nice. ship it. :shipit:

 dan: create a short postmortem note in incidents/ once merged.

 samir: done — added brief note and link to PR.

 jin: I'll update CI matrix docs to document SHARD_SEED behavior.

 maya: thanks team.
